homepage.summary: Topology-aware world models for electricity-grid reconfiguration — ranking line-switching candidates via learned imagined rollouts, verified by exact AC power-flow simulation.

current.desc: Topology-aware world model for electricity-grid reconfiguration that evaluates line-switching candidates through learned imagined rollouts and verifies promising actions using exact AC power-flow simulation — covering topology-changing actions, ranking of candidates, and identification of unsafe or poor candidates. Experiments are ongoing; no performance claims are made.

homepage.summary: Whether token-level logits, probabilities and generation-time signals from autoregressive LLMs give reliable evidence of incorrect or unsupported outputs.

current.desc: Investigating whether generation-time signals from autoregressive language models — particularly token-level logit and probability structure — can provide reliable evidence of output correctness, whether these signals distinguish reliable from incorrect or unsupported outputs, and how robust they are across models, tasks and decoding conditions.
